scripts.start: npm run ensure:interfaces && ng serve --host=127.0.0.1 --proxy-config proxy.conf.cjs
scripts.build:prod: npm run ensure:interfaces && ng build --configuration production
scripts.watch: npm run ensure:interfaces && ng build --watch --configuration development
scripts.test: npm run ensure:interfaces && npm run test:proxy && node ../scripts/run-ui-tests.mjs
